---
title: "3.7 Out-of-process third-party captains"
planned: true
---

Catalog captains run in their own worker with only their scoped credentials: no Docker socket, no database admin, no secrets.

- Size: L, one to two months
- Design: [docs/specs/access-model.md](/docs/specs/access-model.md)
